questions.question: In Jesus' parable of the vineyard tenants, why did the landowner send his servants when harvest time drew near?

answers.text: To collect his share of the fruit
To help bring in the harvest
To check on the wall and tower

questions.question: In Jesus' parable of the vineyard tenants, who did the landowner send last, after the tenants mistreated his servants?
Jesus told His listeners that the kingdom of God would be taken away from them. Who would it be given to?

answers.text: A people who would produce its fruit
The servants who were sent first
The builders who rejected the stone

questions.question: After Jesus told the parable of the wicked tenants, what did the chief priests and Pharisees realize?

answers.text: Jesus was speaking about the crowds
Jesus was speaking about tax collectors
